basic_details.job_title: RIMS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Accountant, Junior Auditor Posts
basic_details.short_information: Regional Institute of Medical Sciences, Imphal, Manipur (RIMS) has invited applications for 2 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. No.406/CMHT/PMJAY/RIMSH-2025. The posts include Accountant, Junior Auditor. Applications are accepted online until 12 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 30 years (on the last date of submission of application form)
age_limit.details: Age relaxation for all posts: OBC Relaxable as per Rules, SC Relaxable as per Rules, PWD Relaxable as per Rules.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate, Master's degree, depending on the post

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Degree in Commerce from recognized university. Essential: Possessing 2(two) years experience of handling accounts work. Desirable: Post Graduate in Commerce from a recognized university. Experience required: 2 years experience of handling accounts work. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Level-3 + DA (as applicable). Qualification required: Degree in Commerce from recognized university. Essential: 2 (two) years' experience in handling audit work. Desirable: Post Graduate in Commerce from a recognized university. Experience required: 2 years experience in handling audit work. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Level-3 + DA (as applicable).

how_to_apply: Get the application form: RIMS Website.
Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of your certificates.
important_instructions: Candidates who have already submitted their online application are not required to submit their application again and will be considered by the Scrutiny Committee.

content_sections.text: Get the application form: RIMS Website. Fill in the form and attach self-attested copies of your certificates. Apply on or before 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Accountant, 1 Junior Auditor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All Candidates: Rs. 1,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years (on the last date of submission of application form). Relaxation: OBC Relaxable as per Rules, SC Relaxable as per Rules, PWD Relaxable as per Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-3 + DA (as applicable) for Accountant, Level-3 + DA (as applicable) for Junior Auditor.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate, Master's degree, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Shortlisting of eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 6 (Six) months (extendable as per requirement & performance of the incumbent). Strictly co-terminus with the scheme.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Imphal.
